annotation.title_clean: Kenya: Artificial Intelligence Readiness Assessment Report
annotation.title_en: Kenya: Artificial Intelligence Readiness Assessment Report
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNESCO; Research ICT Africa; Global Center on AI Governance
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology report on Kenya's AI ecosystem, covering legal, social, educational, economic and technical dimensions, national consultations and policy recommendations aligned with the UNESCO Recommendation on AI ethics. It informs Kenya's national AI strategy; robotics appears only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Diagnoses Kenya's AI landscape across legal, socio-cultural, scientific, economic and technical dimensions
Reviews Data Protection Act 2019, ICT Policy 2019 and Digital Master Plan 2022-2032
Draws on consultations with over 300 stakeholders in 2024
Recommends AI governance, capacity-building, socio-cultural impact and investment measures
Supports Kenya's drafting of a national AI and emerging technology strategy
